MP4Box.js 2.4.1 (BSD-3-Clause), vendored from the published npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/mp4box/-/mp4box-2.4.1.tgz

Upstream: https://github.com/gpac/mp4box.js

The three .mjs files are unmodified distribution files. Source map files are
omitted; they are not required at runtime. LICENSE contains the upstream license.
The extension imports these local files and makes no network requests.
